animations.name: Medium Kick Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE heavy Honda-style SF6 crouching medium kick across the clip (one kick only, never twice), pure body motion in empty air: NEVER rise or stand up—keep hips and head strictly low at crouch height throughout wind-up, kick, and recovery. Alberto leans his sturdy torso back-left onto his low bent support leg so his hips shift slightly left, then drives ONE heavy, solid straight low kick forward along the ground baseline with crisp solid sneaker (NO motion blur) stopping with generous empty margin before the right edge of the 512x512 frame; brief apex hold, then smooth retraction back into the starting kneeling crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, glasses, beard, green sweater, grey jeans, white sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
